svg.title: The standards packs, test by test
svg.desc: Every test of the three scored standards packs, from real runs of engine v0.40.0 (`kshana standards-pack run`): dhs-rpcf: 6 met, 1 not met, 2 need an input; imo-circ-1575: 1 met, 4 not met, 2 need an input; icao-doc9849-appf: 6 met, 0 not met, 2 need an input. In all, 13 met, 5 not met and 6 need an input the engine does not have (a receiver log or equipment documentation). Each bar was stated before the run; a miss is kept as a miss. A met bar says a modelled scenario met a stated bar, nothing about a product. The packs support evidence for the rows they cite; they are not an assessment. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service; it must not be the sole basis for any navigation or safety decision.
